name: Rice-snail pancake
summary: Bánh xèo ốc gạo is the rice-snail pancake named with the coconut dishes. It is a different plate from the town pancake of coconut milk and turmeric.
origin: Named on the provincial tourism overview of 4 November 2021.
howToEat: Order it by this name. The overview does not give a batter or a herb plate. The town pancake with turmeric, coconut milk, clam, shrimp, pork, and cassava is the 9 June 2021 plate.
seoTitle: Rice-snail pancake in Ben Tre — bánh xèo ốc gạo
seoDescription: Bánh xèo ốc gạo is the rice-snail pancake named with the coconut dishes.
